targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM client_configs WHERE onboarding_status = 'active'
SELECT SUM(cost_cents)::float / 100 AS dollars FROM cost_events WHERE occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW())
SELECT count(*) FROM document_intake WHERE status = 'done' AND processed_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'

SELECT c.name AS client, cc.tier, cc.onboarding_status, COALESCE(mtd.cents,0)::float/100 AS mtd_usd, COALESCE(ag.n,0) AS agents, latest.created_at AS last_health FROM client_configs cc LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = cc.company_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT company_id, SUM(cost_cents) AS cents FROM cost_events WHERE occurred_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) GROUP BY company_id) mtd ON mtd.company_id = cc.company_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT company_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM agents GROUP BY company_id) ag ON ag.company_id = cc.company_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT created_at FROM client_health_snapshots WHERE client_uuid = cc.company_id ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1) latest ON true ORDER BY mtd.cents DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT date_trunc('hour', occurred_at) AS time, COALESCE(c.name, ce.company_id::text) AS metric, SUM(cost_cents)::float/100 AS value FROM cost_events ce LEFT JOIN companies c ON c.id = ce.company_id WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
